attributes.name: Toadstorm
attributes.powers: Display this card next to any location. While displayed, characters at that location add 2d6 and the Poison trait to their combat checks. At the end of the turn, each character at the location is dealt 2 Poison damage, then if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at an Arcane 15 or Divine 13 check to recharge it instead.
